claim_summary: For each k>=1, the ordered additive energy of {(x,x^4):x in Z/2^k Z} is 4^k(B_r 2^m-(k+14)) for k=4m+r, 1<=r<=4, B=(17,19,23,30), equivalently E_k=(k+6)4^k+512E_{k-4} for k>=5 with E_1..E_4=(8,48,384,3072); by finite Fourier orthogonality this is the complete unweighted fourth moment.
integrity: All arguments and checking instructions are self-contained in the embedded text and standard-library checker. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted fourth Fourier moment only; no claim about sharp arbitrary-coefficient restriction norms, other prime powers, pointwise sumset histograms, or historical priority. Unindexed two-adic representation-density results are a residual overlap risk. Finite enumerations corroborate but cannot replace the all-k proof.
title: Four-adic energy resonance of the dyadic quartic Fourier graph
